title: Selection Rule: The Supplement Behind an Insurer Extension (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Selection rule.** For an insurer extension on a Rental Vehicle Coordination insurance rental, the extension's supplement is chosen from the decisions on the repair order's supplements: where the insurer approved a supplement in full, it is the latest supplement approved in full; where none was approved in full but the insurer partly approved one, it is the latest supplement partly approved; otherwise it is the latest supplement submitted.

## Records read

The supplements of the insurance claim repair order under Insurance Claim Repairs that the rental is for, by supplement number, and the insurer's decision on each (approved in full, partly approved, denied, or not yet decided).

## Selection table

| Any supplement approved in full | Any supplement partly approved | Extension's supplement |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | The latest approved in full |
| No | Yes | The latest partly approved |
| No | No | The latest submitted |

## Hypothetical cases

- Supplement 1 approved in full, supplement 2 partly approved, supplement 3 denied: the extension's supplement is supplement 1.
- Supplement 1 partly approved, supplement 2 partly approved: supplement 2.
- Supplement 1 denied, supplement 2 submitted and not yet decided: supplement 2, the latest submitted.
